device.description: 24-bit 20.8 kSPS 4-channel delta-sigma ADC with 2-wire serial interface (DOUT/DRDY, SCLK)
device.note: ads1254.pdf (SBAS213B) p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3 electrical characteristics (data rate 20.8 kHz at CLK 8 MHz, DVDD 1.8-3.6 V, AVDD 4.75-5.25 V, data format offset two's complement), p.7 channel selection (Table I), p.8 Table II CLK vs data rate, p.11 DOUT/DRDY, synchronization, power-down, p.12 serial interface, data format (Table IV), Table III digital timing

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the CHSEL1/CHSEL0 pin levels (Table I: 00 = CH1, 01 = CH2, 10 = CH3, 11 = CH4)

pages: p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3 electrical characteristics (data rate 20.8 kHz at CLK 8 MHz, DVDD 1.8-3.6 V, AVDD 4.75-5.25 V, data format offset two's complement), p.7 channel selection (Table I), p.8 Table II CLK vs data rate, p.11 DOUT/DRDY, synchronization, power-down, p.12 serial interface, data format (Table IV), Table III digital timing
notModeled: conversion cycle tDRDY = 384 tOSC = 48 us at the nominal CLK = 8 MHz; the data rate scales with CLK (Table II; the CLK pin is not used)

DOUT/DRDY partitioning: DRDY mode (t4 high 24 tOSC, t2 low pulse 6 tOSC = 750 ns, t3 high 6 tOSC) then DOUT mode with the MSB on the pin (t7); modeled as an active-low ready pulse of t2 followed by the data; the t3 high period and t4 high before the next DRDY are not modeled
after more than 24 SCLKs DOUT/DRDY stays low until t4 (idle '0'); after an incomplete read the last bit read stays on the pin
synchronization (SCLK held high for 4 to 20 DOUT/DRDY periods resets the modulator) and power-down (SCLK held high for 20 periods; released on SCLK falling)
digital filter settling (five conversions after a step or channel change)
channel selection by CHSEL1/CHSEL0 (stored only; every channel returns the 0 V code); a channel change holds DOUT/DRDY high for t18 = 2043.5 tOSC
variants: ADS1250-ADS1254 family: ADS1251, ADS1252, ADS1253 have separate datasheets and spec files; ADS1254 is the 4-channel, separate AVDD/DVDD version (20-pin SSOP)
